amy.marketing: Quick thought  run a 10-day push: tiny OSS refkit, 3 snack tutorials, and a benchmark we can reproduce. Goal: community traction + signups.

sam.devrel: Yes. Tutorials: Quickstart (10m), Latency tune (12m), Add model (15m). Will add clear copy-paste steps.

rachel.content: I'll draft launch post + two tweet threads (launch + dev thread). Need bench CSV and a short engineer quote.

noah.eng: I'll run perf harness on g6/g5. fp16 vs int4, batch 1/4, seq 128. ETA 30h. bot.ci: perf job queued for 03:30 UTC.

drew.growth: Routing idea: gated repo download -> flows: enterprise -> SDR, OSS contributors -> devrel nurture, others -> marketing drip.

lena.sales: Qualification rules suggestion: company_size>=75 or monthly_tokens>=150000 => SDR. Flag github_org -> devrel-high-intent.

amy.marketing: Messaging options for hero: A) "Refkit Lite: a tested starter to ship LLM features" B) "Reproducible benchmarks, dev-friendly starter" We'll A/B test.

sam.devrel: Add mini-eval notebook and CONTRIBUTING.md so maintainers can reproduce and contribute.

noah.eng: Bench done: g6 int4 batch1 seq128 -> ~2.1x tokens/sec vs fp16. Uploading CSV+readme to repo.

rachel.content: Got CSV. Draft will call out model, seq len, batch, region, and link to reproducible repo. Tone: developer-first, transparent.

drew.growth: Also request an email variant for maintainers highlighting contribution perks.

lena.sales: SDR playbook draft incoming with 3 opening lines + qualification checklist.

amy.marketing: Action items: noah -> bench artifacts (24h), sam -> tutorials (5d), rachel -> post + social (48h), drew -> landing + routing (48h), lena -> SDR playbook (48h). Quick sync tomorrow to lock dates. :rocket:
